Build & Deliver RTIQA v1 — Global Multi-Tenant EdTech Platform
Read Before Applying
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Technical Lead, or capable engineering team to take ownership of RTIQA and deliver RTIQA v1 as a complete, functional, scalable, production-ready educational platform.
This is NOT a small feature task, UI redesign, prototype, or demo. The selected freelancer will be responsible for delivering the complete scope described below.
Review the public repositories before applying:
Current implementation:
https://github.com/rtiqa/rtiqa-website.git⁠�
Product vision and architecture:
https://github.com/rtiqa/rtiqa.git⁠�
AI / technical exploration:
https://github.com/rtiqa/rtiqa-ai.git⁠�
After review, provide your technical recommendation: continue, refactor, preserve valuable components and rebuild weak ones, consolidate repositories, or rebuild from scratch if justified.
The engineering approach is open. The required final product scope is fixed.
Generic copy-paste proposals that show no understanding of RTIQA or the repositories will not be considered.
PROJECT VISION
RTIQA is a global, scalable, multi-tenant EdTech SaaS platform combining:
School Management System (SIS)
Learning Management System (LMS)
Student Information Management
Parent Engagement
Assessments and Academic Records
Certificates and Verification
Notifications and Communication
AI-powered educational tools
The architecture must support future growth toward thousands of institutions and millions of users without requiring a complete rewrite.
REQUIRED RTIQA v1 SCOPE
1. Platform, Multi-Tenancy & Security
Build a secure multi-tenant SaaS platform supporting multiple independent schools with strong tenant data isolation, platform and school administration, scalable database/API architecture, authentication, authorization and role-based access control.
Core roles:
Platform Administrator
School Administrator
Academic Administrator
Teacher
Student
Parent / Guardian
Users must only access authorized data and functionality.
2. Arabic, English & Internationalization
RTIQA must support Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) from day one, including language selection and an architecture ready for future languages, time zones, date formats and localization.
3. Institution & Academic Management
Schools must manage institution profiles, academic years, terms/semesters, grades, classes, sections, subjects, academic structures and teacher assignments.
The data model must remain flexible for different educational systems.
4. Student Management
Complete student workflows including registration, profiles, enrollment, class assignment, academic information/history, promotion between levels and parent/guardian relationships.
Student data must integrate with attendance, learning, assessments, grades, certificates and parent access.
5. Teacher Workspace
Teachers must manage assigned classes and subjects, students, lessons, learning materials, attendance, assignments, assessments, grading and AI educational tools.
6. Student Portal
Students must access a functional dashboard with courses, lessons, learning materials, assignments/submissions, assessments/exams, results, grades, attendance, certificates, notifications and AI learning assistance.
7. Parent / Guardian Portal
Parents are required in RTIQA v1 and must support multiple children, with secure access to attendance, absences, grades, performance, assignments, assessment results, announcements, notifications and certificates.
8. Attendance
Support present, absent and late status, daily/class attendance, student history and reports, with notification integration where appropriate.
9. Learning Management
Manage courses, units, lessons, learning materials, documents/files, educational media, course structure, student access and learning progress where applicable.
10. Assignments
Complete workflow:
Create → assign → deadline → student submission → teacher review → feedback → grade.
11. Assessments & Exams
Support question banks, multiple choice, true/false and short-answer questions, online/timed assessments, automatic/manual grading, results and academic record integration.
12. Grades & Academic Records
Support grade entry, assessment results, academic performance, progress tracking, report cards and academic history, with flexibility for future grading systems.
13. Certificates & Verification
Required in v1:
Certificate templates
Completion/achievement certificates
Institution branding
Unique certificate IDs
PDF generation
QR code
Public verification page
Certificates must be verifiable digital records, not merely PDFs.
14. Announcements & Notifications
Support targeted announcements for all users, teachers, students, parents or specific classes/groups.
Notification foundation must include in-app and email notifications, with an architecture ready for Push/SMS integration.
15. Dashboards, Reports & Export
Role-based dashboards and useful reports covering school activity, students, attendance, academic performance, classes and teacher activity, with export where appropriate.
16. Practical AI Features
AI must provide real educational value, not simply embed a generic chatbot.
Teachers: lesson planning, quiz/question generation, assignment generation and content summaries.
Students: lesson explanations, simplified explanations, practice questions and revision assistance.
AI architecture must consider security, permissions, tenant isolation, cost control, model-provider flexibility and future RAG/knowledge-base integration.
17. Search, Mobile & Connectivity
Provide search for relevant entities/content including students, teachers, courses and educational materials.
The platform must work well on desktop, tablet and mobile browsers.
Provide a practical foundation for unreliable internet where appropriate, including PWA capabilities, local caching, offline access to suitable content, offline action handling, synchronization architecture and conflict-handling strategy.
Avoid unnecessary complexity while establishing a real foundation for low-connectivity environments.
ENGINEERING & PRODUCTION REQUIREMENTS
The project is not complete based only on visible screens.
Final delivery must include:
Clean, maintainable and properly structured code
Clear documented architecture and technical decisions
Proper database design and migrations
API documentation where applicable
Secure authentication and authorization
Strong tenant isolation
Input validation and secure secrets management
Error handling and critical workflow testing
Reliable background processing where applicable
Performance optimization
Environment configuration
CI/CD
Staging and production deployment
Logging and monitoring
Backup and recovery strategy
Documentation sufficient for future maintenance
SCALABILITY
RTIQA must not be designed only for one small school.
The architecture must be capable of evolving toward thousands of institutions, millions of users, high concurrent activity, database growth, scalable APIs, caching, background processing, scalable file storage and observability.
Do not introduce unnecessary microservices or over-engineering.
The goal: simple enough to build and maintain today, but strong enough to scale without a complete architectural rewrite tomorrow.
FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
The project will be considered complete only when a real school can:
Manage its institution and academic structure
Add teachers and students
Link parents/guardians
Manage classes and subjects
Record attendance
Create courses, lessons and learning materials
Create assignments and receive submissions
Create assessments/exams and grade students
Maintain academic records and publish results
Generate and verify certificates
Send announcements and notifications
Provide functional teacher, student and parent portals
Provide practical AI educational assistance
Support Arabic and English
Work reliably on desktop and mobile
Be deployed and ready for real-world use
The project is not considered complete simply because code has been written or screens have been designed.
Completion requires the agreed functionality to be implemented, functional, integrated, tested, accessible to the correct roles, free from critical blocking defects, deployed successfully and sufficiently documented.
Major missing functionality listed in this scope means the project is incomplete.
WHAT WE EXPECT FROM APPLICANTS
Before applying:
Review the repositories.
Understand the complete scope.
Form an independent technical opinion.
State whether you recommend continuing, refactoring, partially rebuilding or rebuilding from scratch.
Briefly explain why.
We are looking for strong engineering judgment and product ownership.
We define WHAT must be delivered. You recommend HOW it should be built.
We are not looking for someone to simply add features to a website. We are looking for someone capable of taking responsibility for delivering RTIQA v1 as a complete, functional, scalable, production-ready educational platform.

High-Converting Local Service Landing Page

I’m looking for an experienced conversion copywriter/web designer to create a single-page, conversion-focused landing page for a local waxing and skincare business.

The business specializes in Brazilian waxing, body waxing, facials, vagacials, and advanced skincare treatments.

The primary goal is to turn online visitors into booked appointments, especially first-time Brazilian waxing clients who may be nervous, unsure, comparing providers, or concerned about pain, embarrassment, or ingrown hairs.

This needs to be a sales tool—not simply a pretty webpage.

Target Customer

Our primary audience is women who may be:

* Getting their first Brazilian wax
* Nervous about pain
* Embarrassed or uncomfortable
* Worried about being judged
* Dealing with razor bumps or ingrown hairs
* Frustrated with inconsistent waxing
* Tired of switching waxers
* Looking for a more personalized experience than a chain
* Looking for an experienced professional who understands both waxing and skin

The messaging should feel professional, comfortable, knowledgeable, judgment-free, and approachable.

The tone should feel like an experienced esthetician calmly guiding someone through the process—not a salesperson pushing a booking.

Core Positioning

A key positioning concept is being known as a “First-Time Wax Specialist.”

This does not mean the business only serves first-time clients. It means we understand that many clients are nervous because they don’t know what to expect.

The desired reaction is:

“Okay. I feel like I can actually do this.”

Brand positioning:

Approachable expertise + personalized care + professional results.

Primary Goal

BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Use strategically placed CTAs throughout the page.

Possible CTA language:

* Book Your Appointment
* Book Your Brazilian
* Ready When You Are — Book Now
* Start Your Waxing Journey
* Book Your First Brazilian

Please recommend the strongest CTA based on conversion strategy.

Required Section 1: Local Service Area

The page must clearly communicate that this is a local business serving a defined geographic area.

The actual city/service area will be provided privately to the selected freelancer.

SEO should naturally target terms such as:

* Brazilian wax [City] [State]
* Brazilian waxing [City]
* Waxing [City] [State]
* Body waxing [City] [State]
* Esthetician [City] [State]
* Facials [City] [State]

Include a section such as:

Serving [City] & Nearby Communities

A map, location cue, or other local trust signal may be recommended.

Required Section 2: Reviews & Trust

Trust is especially important because Brazilian waxing is an intimate service.

Create a prominent testimonial/review section using authentic client reviews that I will provide.

Testimonials may highlight:

* First-time experiences
* Feeling comfortable
* Pain/anxiety concerns
* Professionalism
* Cleanliness
* Results
* Ingrown/razor-bump concerns
* Personalized service
* Returning consistently

Possible trust signals include review ratings, review counts, credentials, cleanliness cues, and local-business credibility.

Never fabricate testimonials, ratings, credentials, awards, or statistics.

Required Section 3: Services & Pricing

Pricing must be transparent and easy to find.

Primary service:

Brazilian Wax — $65 regular price

A current promotional/new-client offer may also be incorporated.

Additional services may include:

* Body Waxing
* Vagacial
* Facials
* Skin Treatments
* Advanced skincare

Do not overwhelm the visitor with every service. Brazilian waxing should remain the primary conversion path, with skincare as a secondary opportunity.

Please recommend the best service hierarchy.

Messaging Strategy

The copy should address objections instead of simply listing services.

For example:

“Nervous about your first Brazilian? You don’t have to know exactly what to do. We’ll walk you through the experience so you know what to expect before we begin.”

Address questions such as:

* Will it hurt?
* What if I’ve never been waxed?
* What if I’m embarrassed?
* What if I get ingrowns?

R-Luxe Transportation – CRM, Booking, Dispatch & Workflow Automation System

We are a New York-based luxury black SUV transportation company seeking an experienced Automation Specialist / CRM Developer to build a streamlined operating system for our business.

Clients contact us through WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Facebook Messenger, Website inquiries and Phone calls.

Our current process is highly manual:
Inquiry → Collect Info → Quote → Follow-Up → Client Accepts → Collect Missing Info → Payment → Reservation → Confirmation → Calendar → Assign Chauffeur → Dispatch → Complete Ride → Chauffeur Payout → Review Request

We want to automate most routine work while keeping management in control of exceptions, unusual pricing, complaints, driver issues and payments.

Our preferred architecture is likely Airtable or similar CRM/database + Make.com/Zapier + APIs/Webhooks + Square + Calendar + Messaging + Flight Tracking. We are open to better recommendations. We want a reliable, scalable and easy-to-manage system, not an unnecessarily expensive custom app.

CENTRAL CRM/DATABASE

Every inquiry should create or connect to one client/reservation record containing information such as:
Client name, phone, email, communication channel, service date/time, airport, flight, terminal, pickup, destination, passengers, luggage, vehicle, car seat, stops, return transfer, quoted/final rate, payment status, chauffeur, chauffeur compensation, reservation status, inquiry source and notes.

Each reservation should receive a unique ID. Repeat clients should connect to their existing history rather than creating duplicates.

MULTI-CHANNEL INQUIRIES

Where technically possible, WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Facebook Messenger and Website inquiries should automatically create/update the appropriate lead/reservation.

For phone inquiries, we need a quick internal intake form.

The system should determine what information is missing and request only those items.

Example: Client provides JFK, date, Manhattan destination and 4 passengers but no luggage or flight information. The system should request only the missing details. Clients should not repeatedly be asked for information already provided.

AUTOMATED QUOTING

We have standardized pricing for many airport transfers based on airport, passenger count, route, vehicle, stops, car seats and other rules.

Pricing should live in an editable rules table.

Standard reservations should be automatically priced and quoted. Nonstandard situations should go to management review. The system should also support offering return airport transportation when appropriate.

PIPELINE & FOLLOW-UP

Suggested statuses:
NEW INQUIRY
MISSING INFORMATION
READY TO QUOTE
QUOTE SENT
FOLLOW-UP
QUOTE ACCEPTED
AWAITING INFORMATION
AWAITING PAYMENT
CONFIRMED
DRIVER NEEDED
DRIVER ASSIGNED
IN PROGRESS
COMPLETED
DRIVER PAYOUT DUE
REVIEW REQUESTED
CLOSED
CANCELLED
LOST
NEEDS MANAGEMENT REVIEW

If a client does not respond to a quote within a defined period, the system should send an automated follow-up.

BOOKING & SQUARE PAYMENT

When a client accepts a quote, the system should record acceptance, check for missing information, request outstanding details and begin the payment/confirmation workflow.

We currently use Square.

Where practical:
Confirmed Reservation → Square Payment Link → Client Pays → Square API/Webhook → Reservation Marked PAID

Track amount quoted, amount charged, amount collected, balance, payment date and payment status.

CALENDAR & CONFIRMATIONS

Once confirmed, a properly formatted calendar event should automatically be created using our existing reservation templates.

Reservations contain client details, flight information, pickup, airport/terminal instructions, passengers, luggage, destination, vehicle, rate, dispatch information and special requests.

Airport pickup instructions should come from an editable rules table based on airport/terminal.

After booking, confirmation should automatically be sent through Email, SMS and/or WhatsApp depending on the client's channel. We already have established communication templates.

DISPATCH DASHBOARD

We need a simple dashboard showing:
Today's rides
Tomorrow's rides
Assigned/unassigned drivers
Missing information
Outstanding payments
Flight issues
Cancelled rides
Completed rides
Reservations needing attention

Example:
7:30 AM – Smith – Manhattan → JFK – Aaron
10:00 AM – Jones – EWR → Manhattan – Peter
1:45 PM – Patel – JFK → Manhattan – UNASSIGNED

Management should primarily review exceptions rather than manually checking every reservation.

DRIVER ASSIGNMENT

Driver records should contain name, phone, email, vehicle, license plate, active status and compensation information.

When management assigns a chauffeur, the system should ideally:
Update reservation
Change status to DRIVER ASSIGNED
Add chauffeur to calendar invitation
Send chauffeur dispatch details
Send chauffeur/vehicle details to client
Record assignment

This should require as little manual work as possible.

Client price and chauffeur compensation must remain separate. Drivers should not see internal margins.

FLIGHT TRACKING

We would like a reliable flight-status API to monitor delays, estimated/actual arrival, cancellations and terminal changes.

Important changes should flag the reservation and notify management/driver according to predefined rules.

Please recommend an appropriate flight API and expected recurring cost.

DRIVER PAYOUTS

After completion, reservations should enter DRIVER PAYOUT DUE.

Management needs a payout queue showing each chauffeur and amount owed.

We currently use Zelle and understand direct Zelle automation may not be practical. At minimum, we need an accurate payout ledger with management approval before funds are released.

REVIEW AUTOMATION

After a completed ride, automatically send a review request after a configurable period with Google/Facebook review links.

Track whether requests were sent so clients are not repeatedly contacted.

NEEDS MANAGEMENT REVIEW

This is extremely important. Automation should NOT blindly process unusual situations.

Examples:
Nonstandard route
Large group
Multiple stops
Unknown pricing
Discount request
VIP/special request
Complaint
Wedding/event transportation
Flight cancellation
Driver cancellation
Payment discrepancy
Duplicate reservation
Missing critical information
Automation/API failure
Low-confidence AI interpretation

Routine reservations should be automated. Exceptions should be clearly surfaced for human review.

MANAGEMENT DASHBOARD & REPORTING

We want one dashboard showing:
New inquiries
Quotes sent/accepted
Conversion rate
Confirmed/upcoming rides
Unassigned rides
Revenue booked
Payments collected/outstanding
Driver payouts
Cancellations
Lost quotes
Items needing attention

Useful reporting includes monthly revenue, reservation count, average booking value, inquiry source, conversion rate, repeat clients, cancellation rate, driver costs, gross margin and outstanding balances.

AI USAGE

We are open to responsible AI for:
Extracting reservation information from messages
Identifying missing information
Drafting replies
Classifying inquiries
Recognizing quote acceptance
Summarizing conversations
Flagging unusual requests

AI should NOT have uncontrolled authority over unusual pricing, refunds, complaints, driver payouts or sensitive decisions. Low-confidence situations should go to management review.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

The system should be reliable, easy to use, secure, scalable, mobile-friendly where practical, modular and documented.

It should include duplicate prevention, error handling, automation logs and human override capability.

We prefer organized modular automations instead of one enormous workflow that is difficult to troubleshoot.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE

Experience with several of the following:
Airtable
Make.com
Zapier
APIs/Webhooks
Square API
WhatsApp Business API
Twilio/SMS
Meta/Facebook Messenger
Email/Calendar automation
OpenAI/AI integrations
Flight APIs
CRM/database architecture
Transportation/dispatch systems

Transportation, limousine, chauffeur, travel or dispatch experience is a major advantage.

APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please do not send a generic proposal. Answer:

1. What architecture would you recommend and why?
2. Would you use Airtable as the main CRM/database?
3. Make.com, Zapier, custom APIs or a combination?
4. How would you consolidate WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Facebook Messenger, Website and Phone inquiries?

11. What software/API subscriptions and monthly costs should we expect?
12. Show examples of similar systems you personally built.
13. Will you personally perform the work or use a team?
14. Estimated development timeline?

Begin your proposal with R-LUXE AUTOMATION so we know you read the description.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

Reservation information should be entered once and flow through the entire lifecycle instead of management repeatedly copying information between messages, quotes, calendars, payments, chauffeur communications and follow-ups.

Routine airport reservations should require minimal management intervention.

Management should primarily handle exceptions, unusual pricing, VIP requests, complaints, driver issues, chauffeur assignment oversight, payout approval and general operations.

We are looking for someone who can build a professional operating system for a growing luxury transportation company, not simply a few disconnected automations.

•	Bot should answer common questions: event dates, venue, timings, entry fees, dress code, rules, training schedule, contact details, etc.
•	Should support natural-language queries (AI/NLP-based understanding), not just rigid keyword menus.
•	Should offer a quick-reply menu (buttons/lists) alongside free-text understanding, so users can either type naturally or tap options.

•	Collect the same data currently captured via our Google Form: name, age/gender, mobile number, address, city, group/family size, etc. (final field list to be shared with the selected vendor).

•	On successful verification, auto-generate and send a digital payment receipt (PDF/image) with a unique receipt/registration ID.

* Closed/interior geometry and hidden caps at detachable seams so removed parts do not appear hollow.

Shopify Expert Needed
Multi-Store Redesign & Migration of Two Live Jewelry Stores (Turkey & International)

About the Project

We run a heritage jewelry brand on Shopify with two independent, separately hosted, live stores, one for Turkey and one for the international market, plus in-person retail (POS) sales across both markets. The two stores are not connected through Shopify Markets, they are two fully separate Shopify instances that currently carry the same theme framework and largely mirrored content, just localized (Turkish vs. English).

This is a redesign and migration of two operating stores, not a new build. Everything currently live, products, content, reviews, rankings, needs to carry over into the new version. Before full redesign work begins, we need an expert to close the gaps in the current setup (POS reconciliation, tracking, app stack, and how the two catalogs relate to each other), then execute the redesign of both stores together on one shared timeline.

We're looking for a true partner on this project, someone who can advise on structure, content, and user experience, not just execute instructions literally. A genuine sense of taste and judgment for fashion and jewelry brands matters as much as technical skill here.

Project Approach

• Both stores are rebuilt on one shared, premium template, not two separate designs. The same theme is configured and localized across Turkey and international.
• The template itself is designed collaboratively with us. We're looking for a real design partner who proposes and iterates with us, not someone who waits for a finished spec.
• World-class UX is the bar. Every part of the storefront, homepage, navigation, and product experience needs to feel like a premium fashion/jewelry brand, not a generic Shopify theme.
• All new site copy will be written and provided by us. Your role is to implement it cleanly across both languages and make sure every page is fully SEO optimized, meta titles and descriptions, header structure, alt text, structured data, internal linking, and URL/redirect strategy, not to write the copy itself.
• Full product migration for both catalogs is a core deliverable, not an afterthought. Every existing product, and its reviews, needs to carry over cleanly using the cross-store mapping built in the audit phase.
• Existing SEO equity and rankings must be preserved through proper redirects and technical SEO hygiene as part of the migration, this is a hard requirement, not a nice to have.

What's Already Known About the Current Setup

• Two independent Shopify stores (Turkey and International), same Online Store 2.0 theme framework version, not Shopify Markets
• Turkey: roughly 439 products / 840 variants. International: roughly 409 products / 803 variants
• The two catalogs are not linked by handle or SKU today, only 4 handles match exactly between the two stores, so a mapping between equivalent products has to be built before any migration happens
• Inventory locations: 2 on the Turkish store, 3 on the international store including a Portugal-based warehouse
• Roughly half of Turkey's revenue currently comes through POS, not online, so POS reconciliation is core to this work, not a footnote
• Apps currently installed: 31 on the Turkish store, 24 on the international store, 18 shared between them, with known overlap (two competing bundle apps on international, two overlapping email/popup tools on both) that needs auditing and consolidating rather than adding to
• Known gaps to close: no GDPR consent management on the international store, no server-side tracking (GTM, Meta Pixel, Conversions API) on the international store, a Poor Largest Contentful Paint score on the Turkish store's current theme

Scope, Three Phases

Phase 1: Audit & Diagnosis
• Document configuration parity between the two independent stores: domains, currencies, languages, taxes, and where the two setups diverge or overlap
• Audit the POS integration across all inventory locations on both stores and how in-store sales reconcile with online order data
• Review the tracking setup on both stores: GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, deduplication, attribution window consistency, and how POS revenue is or isn't reflected in ad platform reporting. International currently has no serverside tracking at all, this needs to be built, not just audited
• Audit the app stack on both stores and flag what should be consolidated or removed before rebuild
• Build a product mapping between the two catalogs, since no reliable shared identifier currently links equivalent products across the two stores
• Close the GDPR consent gap on the international store ahead of European ad traffic
• Deliver a written report of findings, gaps, and a recommended path forward before full redesign work begins

Phase 2: Full Site Redesign & Migration (both stores, one build)

One premium template, designed together with us, then configured, branded, and deployed across both stores, this is not two independent projects. Both stores move through every stage on the same timeline, since stock, shipping, and fulfillment are shared between them, and both publish together once approved.
• Foundation & Theme Setup: collaborative template design process with us, store configuration, theme build, full brand identity application (colors, typography, buttons, spacing, styling), global layout, header and footer, applied consistently across both stores
• Storefront & Homepage: hero/banner, featured collections, product showcases, brand story, video section, Instagram feed, trust elements, newsletter signup, mega menu, responsive mobile navigation, built to a world-class UX standard, genuinely modern and dynamic, not a reskin of the current structure
• Catalogue & Product Setup: a hero set of roughly 25 to 30 products, covering every category and material combination (rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, sets, in both gold and silver), fully rebuilt with new photography treatment. The remaining catalog (roughly 800 variants combined) migrated using the Phase 1 product mapping, ideally through 
Matrixify, already installed on the Turkish store. Collection functionality, site search, product page template with galleries, zoom, variants, reviews, recommendations, size guides, and stock messaging
• Supporting Pages & Content: About, Contact, FAQ, Size Guide, Shipping & Returns, Privacy Policy/Terms, Store Locator, blog with starter posts, 404 page, Sale/Offers page, in both English and Turkish. All new copy is provided by us, your role is clean implementation plus full on-page SEO optimization of every page
• Conversion & Customer Experience: live chat/chatbot, sticky add-to-cart, cart drawer, customer accounts, checkout branding, Instagram feed. Existing tools reviewed and carried forward where they work, overlapping tools consolidated per the Phase 1 app audit
• SEO, Analytics & Launch Readiness: meta titles/descriptions, alt text, structured data, header hierarchy, internal linking, Search Console and GA4 setup, sitemap, full redirect mapping so current rankings and traffic carry over, payment/shipping/tax/currency review, multi-currency support, cross-browser testing, test orders, tracking and consent parity confirmed on both stores
• Post-Launch Support: one month per store from go-live, troubleshooting within the agreed scope
Phase 3: Ongoing Support (after launch)

We also have an ongoing need beyond the redesign itself: weekly content and product updates, homepage and collection refreshes, and general day-to-day merchandising support across both stores. This continues on a monthly basis after the new site is live. Candidates open to this kind of ongoing relationship, not just a one-time build, are preferred.

Timeline
Our Meta Ads Europe launch is set for September 15 and runs independently of this redesign, on the current site with targeted fixes applied ahead of it. The redesign itself is built on a separate, unpublished version of each store while the current sites stay live, targeting a first live version (hero catalog, both stores) within about three to four weeks of kickoff, with the remaining catalog migrating in behind it.

What We're Looking For

• Real experience with bulk product migration (Matrixify or equivalent), this project involves migrating roughly 800 product variants using a mapping table, not manual entry
• Strong tracking and analytics background: GA4, Meta Pixel/Conversions API, server-side tracking, deduplication

We are prioritizing quality and genuine category understanding over the lowest bid.

items.title: Wix Developer for Consulting Website
items.description:
I am seeking an experienced Wix website designer/developer to build a professional, modern, easy-to-navigate website for my new Georgia-based consulting company, Compass Correctional Navigation, LLC.

Our website/domain is TheWayToHelp.com.

About the Business
Compass Correctional Navigation was created from personal experience. My wife and I both entered the correctional system one day apart, leaving our family with very little understanding of what would happen next or how the correctional process worked.
That experience showed us a significant information gap for individuals preparing for incarceration and the families supporting them.

Compass was created to help bridge that gap.
We provide educational, preparation, and navigation services for individuals preparing to enter the Georgia correctional system and their families. Our goal is to help clients understand the process, prepare for what lies ahead, maintain family connections, and begin planning for successful reentry.
We are not a law firm and do not provide legal advice or legal representation.

Our brand message is:
Knowledge. Preparation. Peace of Mind.

Website Objective
The website should immediately communicate professionalism, trust, discretion, compassion, and hope.

Many visitors will arrive at the website during a stressful and uncertain period in their lives. The site therefore needs to be reassuring and approachable without looking overly institutional, intimidating, or like a law-enforcement/corrections website.

We already have an established Compass logo, nautical theme, brand colors, written content, service descriptions, pricing structure, and other marketing materials that can be provided to the selected designer.

Visual Direction
The design should incorporate our existing Compass branding with a sophisticated nautical/navigation theme.

We envision:
Navy blue, white, gray, and tasteful gold accents
Compass/navigation imagery
Lighthouse, coastline, horizon, or similar imagery where appropriate
Clean professional typography
Generous white space
Modern, upscale consulting-company appearance
Strong but tasteful calls to action
Excellent mobile responsiveness
The nautical theme should communicate direction and guidance, rather than looking like a boating or travel website.

Proposed Website Structure
We anticipate approximately 6 primary pages:
Home — Strong introduction to Compass, who we help, why the company exists, overview of services, calls to action, and consultation request.
About Compass — Company story, mission, values, and a personal message from the Founder explaining why Compass was created.
Services & Pricing — Clear presentation of our consulting packages, currently including an Initial Compass Consultation, Family Navigation Package, Compass Transition Package, and a specialized Executive Transition Package.
Resources — Educational information, FAQs, family resources, and eventually downloadable guides and materials.
Request a Consultation — Professional intake/contact form allowing prospective clients to provide basic information about their circumstances and select the service they are interested in.
Contact — Business contact information, hours, and contact form.
The website will also require appropriate Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Copyright/Proprietary Information, and Disclaimer pages or footer links.

Functionality
The initial website should include:
Wix CMS/editor setup that I can maintain after completion
Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile design
Consultation/contact intake forms
Email notifications for new inquiries
Strong call-to-action buttons
Basic SEO configuration
Google/search-friendly page titles and descriptions
Social-media integration
SSL/security configuration
Connection to our existing domain, TheWayToHelp.com
Ability to add online appointment scheduling and payment processing
Ability to add downloadable PDF resources
Ability to expand later with articles/blog content and a secure client area
The site should be structured so these additional features can be added without requiring a complete redesign.

Our Services
Compass assists clients and families with subjects including preparation before reporting, reception and intake, diagnostics and assessment, classification, facility assignment, daily institutional life, family communication, visitation, commissary and financial accounts, educational/program opportunities, and reentry planning.
Again, our role is educational and consultative. We do not represent clients legally, provide legal advice, or claim the ability to influence correctional placement, classification, release, or other government decisions.

Ideal Freelancer
I am looking for someone who:
Has strong experience building professional Wix websites
Has a portfolio demonstrating polished business/service websites
Understands responsive/mobile design
Can work with an existing brand rather than redesigning everything
Has good visual judgment
Can make recommendations when appropriate
Understands forms, scheduling, payments, SEO, and Wix integrations
Communicates clearly and reliably
Is comfortable working collaboratively with a business owner who is relatively new to website development
I am not simply looking for someone to install a Wix template. I want someone who can take our existing brand, story, content, and business model and turn them into a polished, credible professional website.

Materials We Can Provide
The selected freelancer will not be starting from scratch.

We can provide our:
Compass logo • brand colors • business synopsis • mission statement • Founder story • service descriptions • pricing • FAQ content • client guide materials • legal/disclaimer language • business contact information • existing PDF marketing materials.

Our goal is to give the designer the substance and content they need and have them concentrate on turning it into an excellent online presentation.

The End Result
When someone facing incarceration—or a concerned spouse, parent, child, or attorney—visits TheWayToHelp.com, I want them to immediately understand:
There is someone who understands what we're going through. There is a plan. And we don't have to figure all of this out alone.

The website should establish Compass Correctional Navigation, LLC as a professional, trustworthy, confidential, compassionate and knowledgeable resource for individuals and families navigating the Georgia correctional system.

items.description:
Fiverr appstle setup brief · MD
Fiverr Project Brief: Appstle Migration Setup & Coordination
The Task

We're migrating subscriptions from Loyalzoo and WooCommerce Subscriptions into our Shopify store, using Appstle Subscriptions. Appstle's own team will handle the actual technical migration — we need someone to:

Fill out Appstle's migration/import request form correctly, with accurate subscriber and subscription data.
Coordinate directly with Appstle's support team while they run the migration.
Test the results once Appstle completes it, to confirm everything came over correctly before we consider it done.
Background
Legacy systems: Loyalzoo (small subscriber base) and WooCommerce Subscriptions (~150 subscribers, payments processed through Stripe).
Destination: our Shopify store (already built, ready to go live), using Appstle as the subscription app.
Subscriber payment methods are stored in Stripe — the goal is for existing cards to carry over so customers don't have to re-enter payment info.
What we need from you
Gather the required subscriber/subscription export data from Loyalzoo and WooCommerce (we'll provide admin access or exports).
Fill out Appstle's migration intake form accurately and completely.
Submit it and follow up with Appstle support as needed until the migration is scheduled/run.
Once Appstle completes the migration, test a small batch of subscriptions (3-5) to confirm:
The subscription details are correct (product, price, billing interval).
A real charge actually processes successfully on the migrated payment method — not just that the subscription record looks right.
Report back with results, and flag anything that didn't migrate cleanly so we can follow up.
Important context

We're aware of a case where a similar Stripe-to-Shopify migration through Appstle went badly for another merchant — their payment approval rate dropped sharply after migration, and it took over a month of back-and-forth with support to resolve, with real revenue lost in the meantime. This is why testing actual charges (not just checking that the data imported) matters — please don't mark this complete until real charges have been verified.

What we'll provide
Loyalzoo and WooCommerce admin access (or can provide data exports directly).
Shopify store admin access.
Appstle app access within Shopify.
Ideal freelancer background

Familiarity with Shopify and subscription apps (Appstle experience a plus, but not required since their team does the technical work) — mainly need someone detail-oriented who can manage a data intake form accurately and follow through on testing/support coordination.
